contract: Feed complete NAL units from RawAnnexBReader through Decoder::send_nal. The AVC send_nals schedule takes the original seeded one-to-4096-byte cuts, including cuts inside NAL units. Feed only the complete NAL units available at each cut and retain incomplete bytes for the next cut. Every original Annex B byte stays in the same order.

Supply the access unit ordinal as PTS once, on the first AVC slice or the chunk that contains it, or on the first HEVC NAL. FFmpeg assigns the ordinal once to each raw demuxer packet. Flush both decoders after the last input.

Fold kind 1 with exact conformance-window geometry, depth, plane count, optional signed PTS and a 16-byte MD5 of every visible plane in decoder output order. Apply the reference crop without alignment rounding. A failed decode without any pictures folds kind 8. The six nal-workloads rows use the codec workload RGBA fold and native reference worker.

open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.264 (08/2024) sections 7.3.3 and 7.4.3 require a complete slice header and a picture parameter set ID in the range 0 through 255. Annex B.2 defines NAL byte-stream framing.
